title: cynoglottis chetikiana subsp. paphlagonica
intro: Cynoglottis chetikiana subsp. paphlagonica, commonly known as Balkan cynoglottis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglottis chetikiana subsp. paphlagonica include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
